draft.shortGloss: to listen; to hear; to obey
draft.emotion: attentive and quiet, focusing closely on a sound
notes: Use 听 when you deliberately focus your attention on a sound, like listening to music or someone speaking.
Do not confuse it with 听见 (tīng jiàn), which means the physical result of hearing a sound whether you wanted to or not.
